title: A fire spell in the sample project
caption: Every battle effect in the sample project is now made with RPG Reactor's own Effect generator, its sounds with the Sound Effect generator.

title: Building a 2D structure
caption: A 2D structure built on its own plot: its layers and videos listed on the left, the video in hand with its handles, its settings on the right.

title: The tileset picker
caption: A tile layer's tileset chosen from a picker that shows every sheet.

title: A 2D structure placed from the tile palette
caption: The S tab of the tile palette: click a structure, click the map. A placed one is selected, moved and copied right on the map.

title: A 2D structure in the Database
caption: Database › Structures: the structure fills the view and zooms, with its passability marks and its video.

title: Blocking single sides of a cell
caption: Sides blocks just one edge of a cell, like a fence or a ledge, and the game honours it from both directions.

title: Choosing a place on a 3D map
caption: Transfer Player, starting positions and other places are chosen on the map itself, in 3D or from above.

title: The Media Surface editor
caption: The Media Surface editor in the editor's theme.

title: Editor plugins in the Plugin Manager
caption: Editor Plugins: plugins that change RPG Reactor's editor for a project, beside the game's own plugins.
